comparison.objective: Retrieve an out-of-reach jar by pulling its supporting board, then place it in a basket; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Infer and execute indirect support manipulation followed by grasp-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: Scores bringing the jar into reach and ultimately releasing it in the basket without loss; candidate scores locked angular setting and repeated motion.
comparison.reason: Indirect retrieval has no meaningful mechanical or outcome overlap with two-tool stop adjustment.
